components.name: Episode
components.summary: The whole player: the 470 × 835 frame, a canvas for scenes, the header, and the studio deck with word-by-word narration, a scrubber and step, play, expand and…

components.name: Frame
components.summary: The paper the whole series is drawn on: a 470 × 835 graph-paper frame (14px and 70px grids, a warm vignette, 14px corners) that sets --k to its width ÷ 470.

components.name: Header
components.summary: The series line across the top of the frame: "> SPARK INTERNALS / EP.

components.name: Deck
components.summary: The studio deck: a dark panel docked at the bottom of the frame that carries the narration word by word, with the segment label in amber and the clock on its t…

components.name: DeckButton
components.summary: The deck's only button: transparent, uppercase 9px mono, a thin deck-line border that turns amber on hover and green (with a deck-on label) when toggled on.

components.name: Scrubber
components.summary: The episode timeline: a range input in amber with a tick at every segment start, grey for scenes and a taller amber tick for beats.

components.name: SceneTitle
components.summary: The label at the top-left of every scene: number, em dash, name ("05 — COST PIPELINE") in muted 10.5px bold, over a 180px dashed rule.

components.name: StippleText
components.summary: Text that prints itself: each character arrives as a scatter of dots on a 3 × 4 grid, then resolves, left to right.

components.name: Pill
components.summary: A short state or verdict in a capsule: uppercase mono 8.5px bold, 17px tall, half-height corners, a soft drop shadow.

components.name: Card
components.summary: A raised sheet of paper with a 1.2px ink outline, 8px corners and a soft shadow, for figures that need their own frame: the stage readout, the cost card, the p…

components.name: Stat
components.summary: One number that carries the scene, in mono 800 with tabular figures, and the line or two that make it mean something.

components.name: MetricRows
components.summary: Label and value pairs down a card, label in muted lowercase on the left, value bold on the right, a hairline under each row.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.summary: Stage progress as a white track filled with green hatching; when a stage stalls, the leading 14px turns to red hatching.

components.name: StepList
components.summary: A pipeline as a checklist: done steps get a green box and a white check, the current step an amber box filling up, the rest a muted outline, each with its cost…

components.name: TaskBars
components.summary: Where the time goes around a stage barrier: grey hatched bars for waiting, green hatched bars for real work, and a dashed red line where nothing can start unti…

components.name: DataGrid
components.summary: A small table drawn on the oblique (cells 50 × 17, skewed to match the machines) that shows what a filter and a select keep: kept rows tinted green, dropped ro…

components.name: Terminal
components.summary: The one line of code that sets the scene in motion: an ink bar with an amber "›" prompt, cream code, light green strings and a blinking amber block cursor.

components.name: CodeCompare
components.summary: The anti-pattern beside the fix: two cards, "ANTI-PATTERN" in red and struck through with a thick red-on-ink slash, "DO THIS" in green.

components.name: Record
components.summary: One row as a white card: "ROW", the key field in blue, the rest of the columns in muted.

components.name: Machine
components.summary: Every computer, stage and platform in the series: an oblique box whose front face rises 8.5% across its width and whose depth recedes up and to the left, outli…

components.name: Slab
components.summary: A partition: a flat 26 × 5 × 14 box, grey until it has a key, then filled with that key's color and labeled on top (k1–k4).

components.name: RackGrid
components.summary: A cluster seen from above at 30°: a square of isometric rack tiles, each with vents and an LED.

components.name: Disk
components.summary: Local disk as a short cylinder with a spinning amber needle; active spins it fast and lights the needle.

components.name: Hourglass
components.summary: Waiting, drawn as a wireframe hourglass that turns while amber sand runs down.

components.name: LED
components.summary: A status light: a dot with a soft glow 4.5 times its radius and a small white highlight up and to the left.

components.name: BitRibbon
components.summary: A record turned into bytes: a blue ribbon of 0s and 1s that waves gently while it travels; dense is the compressed form, shorter with tighter bits.

components.name: Pipe
components.summary: The network drawn as a pipe with a narrow throat: in jammed mode full-row blocks queue at the throat and glow red; in flowing mode small blue and green blocks…

components.name: ClosingCard
components.summary: The end card: the series and episode, the lesson as a short serif title, an italic line under it, a dashed rule, the takeaways as pills and one line of config.
